Eight English-only diveComputer.* strings; claims register anchors in DECOMPRESSION-001, NARCOSIS-001 and GAS-001. The model and the narcosis effects are unchanged.

Each file was then restored from its backup and compared with cmp: byte for byte identical in every case.
